{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Nuclear energy is the most reliable zero-carbon emissions source of energy.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Unwarranted fear mongering with no relationship to current technologies and safeguards has prevented the start of construction of a single nuclear power plant in 31 years.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The U.S. Navy has for decades relied upon nuclear-powered vessels.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Other nations have harnessed nuclear power to provide a major portion of their energy consumption.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The United States cannot catch up and harness nuclear power to provide a major portion of its energy consumption.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Republicans will pursue dramatic increases in the use of all forms of safe, affordable, reliable, and clean nuclear power.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"As new nuclear plants are constructed using the highest safety and operation standards, the nation's industrial and manufacturing base will be rejuvenated.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"For every new nuclear plant built, nearly 15,000 high quality jobs will be created.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Those workers will lead the nation away from its dependence on foreign oil.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Alternate power sources must enter the mainstream.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The technology behind solar energy has improved significantly in recent years.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The commercial development of wind power promises major benefits both in costs and in environmental protection.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Republicans support these and other alternative energy sources, including geothermal and hydropower.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Republicans anticipate technological developments that will increase the economic viability of alternative energy sources.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Republicans advocate a long-term energy tax credit equally applicable to all renewable power sources.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Republicans support measures to modernize the nation's electricity grid to provide American consumers and businesses with more affordable, reliable power.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Republicans will work to unleash innovation so entrepreneurs can develop technologies for a more advanced and robust United States transmission system that meets growing energy demands.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Coal is America's most affordable and abundant energy resource and the source of most of the nation's electricity.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Coal remains a strategic national resource that must play a major role in energy independence.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Republicans look to innovative technology to transform America's coal supplies into clean fuels capable of powering motor vehicles and aircraft.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Republicans support coal-to-liquid and gasification initiatives.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Republicans support investment in the development and deployment of carbon capture and storage technologies, which can reduce emissions.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Republicans firmly oppose efforts by Democrats to block the construction of new coal-fired power plants.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"No strategy for reducing energy costs will be viable without a commitment to continued coal production and utilization.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
